name: Dire Straits

whyMatters.en: Mark Knopfler’s fingerstyle Telecaster cut against late-70s hard-rock volume: Sultans of Swing (1978) proved clean tone and narrative lyric could compete on AOR radio without power chords as default.
whyMatters.zh: Mark Knopfler 指弹吉他 Telecaster 顶住 70 年代末 hard-rock 音量：Sultans of Swing（1978）证明干净音色与叙事歌词也能打 AOR，不必默认 power chords。

lyricQuotes: You get a shiver in the dark / It's raining in the park but meantime

shortBio.en: Newcastle four; Knopfler fingerstyle Telecaster, Sultans of Swing as 1978 AOR fingerprint.
shortBio.zh: 纽卡斯尔四人组；Knopfler 指弹 Telecaster，Sultans of Swing 作 1978 AOR 指纹。

body.en:
Formed 1977 in Deptford/Newcastle circle. Debut Dire Straits (1978, Muff Winwood) put Knopfler’s pickless fingerstyle—Strat/Tele through clean Fender amps—against pub-rock storytelling. Sultans of Swing is the citation track: Dorian melody lines over Illsley/Withers pocket, no fuzz wall.

Making Movies (1980) and Brothers in Arms (1985, digital recording, Sting guest on Money for Nothing) scale the band to MTV stadium hard-rock adjacent pop. Core craft remains guitar tone and narrative verse, not riff density.
body.zh:
1977 年在 Deptford/纽卡斯尔圈子组建。首张 Dire Straits（1978，Muff Winwood）把 Knopfler 无拨指弹——Strat/Tele 进干净 Fender 箱头——对准 pub-rock 叙事。Sultans of Swing 是引用曲：Dorian 旋律线压在 Illsley/Withers 口袋拍上，无 fuzz 墙。

Making Movies（1980）与 Brothers in Arms（1985，数码录音，Sting 客串 Money for Nothing）把乐队扩到 MTV 体育场硬摇邻域。核心工艺仍是吉他音色与叙事主歌，非 riff 密度。

note.en: Fingerstyle lead over shuffle pocket; clean Telecaster as hard-rock counter-model.
note.zh: 指弹主音压 shuffle 口袋拍；干净 Telecaster 作 hard-rock 反模型。

note.en: National resonator intro; ballad dynamic before Brothers in Arms scale-up.
note.zh: National 共鸣琴 intro；Brothers in Arms 扩容前的谣曲动态。

note.en: Gibson Les Paul + gated synth texture; MTV-era hard-rock radio hit.
note.zh: Gibson Les Paul + 门限 synth 质感；MTV 期 hard-rock 电台热单。

title.zh: 指弹对抗 hard-rock 音量

body.en:
Knopfler plays without a pick: thumb and fingers articulate bass and melody on one guitar. Early Dire Straits sit next to pub rock and AOR, not NWOBHM.

Sultans of Swing (1978) is the proof track—clean amp, story lyric, lead lines that read like horn phrases.

Later Brothers in Arms adds digital polish; the identity remains guitar craft over distortion ideology.
body.zh:
Knopfler 不用拨片：拇指与手指在一把琴上分出低音与旋律。早期 Dire Straits 靠 pub rock 与 AOR，不靠 NWOBHM。

Sultans of Swing（1978）是证明曲——干净箱头、故事歌词、像号声乐句的主音线。

后期 Brothers in Arms 加数码抛光；身份仍是吉他工艺，非失真意识形态。

title.zh: Knopfler 兄弟到体育场编制

body.en:
Debut lineup: Mark/David Knopfler, Illsley, Withers. David exits 1980; Alan Clark keyboards expand Making Movies.

Brothers in Arms era adds studio and tour players; Mark remains sole lead voice and primary writer.

No classic fracture narrative—scale change is production and TV, not ideology split.
body.zh:
首张阵容：Mark/David Knopfler、Illsley、Withers。David 1980 年离队；Alan Clark 键盘扩 Making Movies。

Brothers in Arms 期加录音室与巡演乐手；Mark 仍是唯一主唱与主写。

无经典分裂叙事——体量变化在制作与电视，非意识形态分裂。

body.en:
Cite path: country/blues fingerstyle into UK pub rock, then US FM. Money for Nothing becomes MTV hard-rock adjacent without abandoning narrative verse.

Later stadium alternative guitarists (delay clean tones) often name Knopfler as tone reference, not riff school.
body.zh:
引用路径：country/blues 指弹进英国 pub rock，再到美国 FM。Money for Nothing 成为 MTV hard-rock 邻域，仍不丢叙事主歌。

后期体育场 alternative 吉他手（干净延时音色）常点名 Knopfler 作音色参照，非 riff 学派。
